d: Capital settlements and historic colonies in Bethesda’s Settled Systems.

gaia-5853498713190525696.x: Sprawling capital city of the United Colonies on planet Jemison in Alpha Centauri, headquarters of Constellation and MAST.

mars.x: Deep-shaft underground mining city on Mars housing the Deimos Staryards offices and industrial extraction workforce.

titan.x: Historic Saturnian colony beneath Titan’s dense nitrogen atmosphere dedicated to preserving pre-evacuation Earth traditions.

b.s: Open-world sci-fi RPG set 50 light-years around Sol in the year 2330, three centuries after humanity’s evacuation from Earth.
